    list.sort((a,b)=>{const aq=a.mtd.quantidade||0,bq=b.mtd.quantidade||0;if(!aq&&!bq)return(b.ytd.nps_index??-999)-(a.ytd.nps_index??-999)||(b.ytd.quantidade||0)-(a.ytd.quantidade||0)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name);if(!aq)return 1;if(!bq)return-1;return(b.mtd.nps_index??-999)-(a.mtd.nps_index??-999)||(b.mtd.quantidade||0)-(a.mtd.quantidade||0)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name)});
    return list;
  }
  const brazil=(channel,keys)=>calc(channel,mergeStats(dealers.filter(d=>d.canais?.[channel]).flatMap(d=>keys.map(k=>d.canais[channel].monthly?.[k]))));
  const brazilD1=channel=>calc(channel,mergeStats(dealers.filter(d=>d.canais?.[channel]).map(d=>d.canais[channel].d1)));

  function fixedRanking(channel,entity='dealer'){
    const isGroup=entity==='group';
    const pane=document.getElementById(`dealerx-${isGroup?'group':'fixed'}-${channel}`);if(!pane)return;
    const list=isGroup?aggregateEntities(channel,d=>d.canais[channel].grupo||'Sem grupo'):sortedDealers(channel);
    const br={d1:brazilD1(channel),mtd:brazil(channel,[current]),ytd:brazil(channel,ytdKeys)};
    const identityHeader=isGroup?'<th>Grupo</th>':'<th>Concessionária</th><th>Regional</th>';
    const cols=`<th>Posição</th>${identityHeader}<th>Qtd. pesquisas D-1</th><th>NPS Index D-1</th><th>Qtd. pesquisas MTD</th><th>NPS Index MTD</th><th>Qtd. pesquisas YTD</th><th>NPS Index YTD</th>`;
    const metricCells=x=>`<td>${fmt(x.d1.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td><td class="${objectiveClass(channel,'nps_index',x.d1.nps_index)}">${fmt(x.d1.nps_index)}</td><td>${fmt(x.mtd.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td><td class="${objectiveClass(channel,'nps_index',x.mtd.nps_index)}">${fmt(x.mtd.nps_index)}</td><td>${fmt(x.ytd.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td><td class="${objectiveClass(channel,'nps_index',x.ytd.nps_index)}">${fmt(x.ytd.nps_index)}</td>`;
    const rows=list.map((item,index)=>{
      const identity=isGroup
        ? `<td class="name">${esc(item.name)}</td>`
        : `<td class="name">${esc(item.dealer.nome)}<small>BIR ${esc(item.dealer.bir||'-')}</small></td><td>${esc(item.dealer.canais[channel].regional)}</td>`;
      const search=isGroup?item.name:`${item.dealer.nome} ${item.dealer.bir}`;
      return `<tr data-fixed-row data-search="${esc(norm(search))}"><td class="rank-position">${isGroup?index+1:item.position}</td>${identity}${metricCells(item)}</tr>`;
    }).join('');
    const totalIdentity=isGroup?'<td class="name">Brasil</td>':'<td class="name">Brasil</td><td>Total</td>';
    const total=`<tr class="dealerx-brasil"><td>-</td>${totalIdentity}<td>${fmt(br.d1.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td><td>${fmt(br.d1.nps_index)}</td><td>${fmt(br.mtd.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td><td>${fmt(br.mtd.nps_index)}</td><td>${fmt(br.ytd.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td><td>${fmt(br.ytd.nps_index)}</td></tr>`;
    const label=isGroup?'Grupos':'Concessionárias';
    const placeholder=isGroup?'Nome do grupo':'Nome ou BIR';
    pane.innerHTML=`<div class="dealerx-panel channel-${channel}"><div class="dealerx-title ${channel}"><span>Ranking · ${label} · ${channel==='vn'?'Vendas':'Pós-Venda'}</span><small>D-1 · MTD · YTD</small></div><div class="dealerx-toolbar"><label>${label}<input type="search" data-fixed-filter placeholder="${placeholder}"></label></div><div class="dealerx-scroll"><table class="dealerx-table" data-fixed-table><thead><tr>${cols}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows}${total}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
    pane.querySelector('[data-fixed-filter]').addEventListener('input',event=>{const q=norm(event.target.value);pane.querySelectorAll('[data-fixed-row]').forEach(row=>row.classList.toggle('hidden',q&&!row.dataset.search.includes(q)));});
  }
  fixedRanking('vn');fixedRanking('vn','group');fixedRanking('pv');fixedRanking('pv','group');

  function timeline(channel){
    const pane=document.getElementById(`dealerx-${channel}`);if(!pane)return;let keys=[current];
    pane.innerHTML=`<div class="dealerx-panel channel-${channel}"><div class="dealerx-title ${channel}"><span>Linha do tempo</span><small>${channel==='vn'?'Vendas':'Pós-Venda'}</small></div><div class="dealerx-toolbar"><div><small>Meses</small><div class="dealerx-chips" data-months>${months.map(m=>`<button class="dealerx-chip ${m.key===current?'active':''}" data-m="${m.key}">${m.label}</button>`).join('')}</div></div><label>Regional<select data-region><option value="">Todas</option>${[...new Set(dealers.filter(d=>d.canais?.[channel]).map(d=>d.canais[channel].regional))].sort().map(r=>`<option>${esc(r)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Concessionária<input data-filter type="search" placeholder="Nome ou BIR"></label><label>Ordenar<select data-order><option value="nps">NPS acumulado</option><option value="qtd">Pesquisas acumuladas</option><option value="name">Concessionária</option></select></label><button class="secondary" data-copy>Copiar tabela</button></div><div class="dealerx-scroll" data-table></div></div>`;
    const render=()=>{
      const region=pane.querySelector('[data-region]').value,q=norm(pane.querySelector('[data-filter]').value),order=pane.querySelector('[data-order]').value;
      let list=dealers.filter(d=>d.canais?.[channel]&&(!region||d.canais[channel].regional===region)&&(!q||norm(d.nome+' '+d.bir).includes(q))).map(d=>({dealer:d,acc:values(d,channel,keys)}));
      list.sort((a,b)=>order==='qtd'?(b.acc.quantidade-a.acc.quantidade)||a.dealer.nome.localeCompare(b.dealer.nome):order==='name'?a.dealer.nome.localeCompare(b.dealer.nome):(b.acc.nps_index??-999)-(a.acc.nps_index??-999)||(b.acc.quantidade-a.acc.quantidade)||a.dealer.nome.localeCompare(b.dealer.nome));
      const periodHeaders=keys.map(key=>{const month=months.find(item=>item.key===key);return `<th colspan="2">${month?.label||key}</th>`}).join('');
      const subHeaders=keys.map(()=>'<th>NPS Index</th><th>Qtd. pesquisas</th>').join('');
      const rows=list.map((item,index)=>`<tr><td class="rank-position">${index+1}</td><td class="name">${esc(item.dealer.nome)}<small>BIR ${esc(item.dealer.bir||'-')}</small></td><td>${esc(item.dealer.canais[channel].regional)}</td>${keys.map(key=>{const value=values(item.dealer,channel,[key]);return `<td class="dealerx-value ${objectiveClass(channel,'nps_index',value.nps_index)}">${fmt(value.nps_index)}</td><td>${fmt(value.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td>`}).join('')}<td class="ytd dealerx-value ${objectiveClass(channel,'nps_index',item.acc.nps_index)}">${fmt(item.acc.nps_index)}</td><td>${fmt(item.acc.quantidade,'quantidade')}</td></tr>`).join('');
      const emptyColspan=5+keys.length*2;
      pane.querySelector('[data-table]').innerHTML=`<table class="dealerx-table timeline-table"><thead><tr><th rowspan="2">Posição</th><th rowspan="2">Concessionária</th><th rowspan="2">Regional</th>${periodHeaders}<th class="ytd" colspan="2">Acumulado selecionado</th></tr><tr>${subHeaders}<th class="ytd">NPS Index</th><th>Qtd. pesquisas</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows||`<tr><td colspan="${emptyColspan}">Nenhum resultado.</td></tr>`}</tbody></table>`;
    };
    pane.querySelectorAll('[data-m]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const k=b.dataset.m;keys=keys.includes(k)?keys.filter(x=>x!==k):[...keys,k].sort();if(!keys.length)keys=[current];pane.querySelectorAll('[data-m]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',keys.includes(x.dataset.m)));render();});['region','filter','order'].forEach(k=>pane.querySelector(`[data-${k}]`).addEventListener(k==='filter'?'input':'change',render));pane.querySelector('[data-copy]').onclick=e=>copyTable(pane.querySelector('table'),e.currentTarget);render();
  }
  timeline('vn'); timeline('pv');

  function generalSummary(){
    const pane=document.getElementById('dealerx-summary');if(!pane)return;
    const metricCols=channel=>channel==='vn'?[['emails_enviados','E-mails enviados'],['emails_entregues','E-mails entregues'],['quantidade','Pesquisas respondidas'],['quantidade_retorno','Quantidade de retorno'],['data_quality','Data Quality'],['taxa_resposta','Taxa de resposta'],['taxa_retorno','Taxa de retorno'],['nps_geral','NPS Satisfação Geral'],['nps_comp1','Competência do consultor'],['nps_comp2','Satisfação na entrega'],['nps_index','NPS Index'],['taxa_test_drive','Taxa oferta Test Drive'],['estrelas','Nota estrela']]:[['emails_enviados','E-mails enviados'],['emails_entregues','E-mails entregues'],['quantidade','Pesquisas respondidas'],['quantidade_retorno','Quantidade de retorno'],['data_quality','Data Quality'],['taxa_resposta','Taxa de resposta'],['taxa_retorno','Taxa de retorno'],['nps_geral','NPS Satisfação Geral'],['nps_comp1','Valorizado como cliente'],['nps_comp2','Qualidade do trabalho'],['nps_index','NPS Index'],['estrelas','Nota estrela']];
    pane.innerHTML='<div class="dealerx-subtabs general-summary-subtabs"><button class="subtab active" data-channel="vn" data-general-target="vn">Vendas</button><button class="subtab" data-channel="pv" data-general-target="pv">Pós-Venda</button></div><div class="general-summary-pane active" data-general-pane="vn"></div><div class="general-summary-pane" data-general-pane="pv"></div>';

    const setupChannel=channel=>{
      const target=pane.querySelector(`[data-general-pane="${channel}"]`);let keys=[current],exportRows=[];
      const regions=[...new Set(dealers.filter(d=>d.canais?.[channel]).map(d=>d.canais[channel].regional).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      target.innerHTML=`<div class="dealerx-panel channel-${channel}"><div class="dealerx-title ${channel}"><span>Resumo geral · ${channel==='vn'?'Vendas':'Pós-Venda'}</span><small>Regional → Grupo → Concessionária</small></div><div class="dealerx-toolbar"><div><small>Meses</small><div class="dealerx-chips">${months.map(month=>`<button class="dealerx-chip ${month.key===current?'active':''}" data-gm="${month.key}">${month.label}</button>`).join('')}</div></div><label>Regional<select data-gregion><option value="">Todas</option>${regions.map(region=>`<option>${esc(region)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Concessionária / grupo<input data-gsearch type="search" placeholder="Pesquisar"></label><button class="export" data-gcopy>Baixar tabelão Excel</button><span class="dealerx-image-status" data-gstatus></span></div><div class="dealerx-scroll" data-general-table-wrap></div></div>`;
      const cols=metricCols(channel);
      const kind=kpi=>['emails_enviados','emails_entregues','quantidade','quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)?'integer':kpi==='estrelas'?'decimal':'percent';
      const render=()=>{
        const rsel=target.querySelector('[data-gregion]').value,q=norm(target.querySelector('[data-gsearch]').value);
        const ds=dealers.filter(dealer=>dealer.canais?.[channel]&&(!rsel||dealer.canais[channel].regional===rsel)&&(!q||norm(dealer.nome+' '+dealer.bir+' '+dealer.canais[channel].grupo).includes(q)));
        const rows=[];exportRows=[];const regionMap=new Map();
        ds.forEach(dealer=>{const region=dealer.canais[channel].regional||'Sem regional',group=dealer.canais[channel].grupo||'Sem grupo';if(!regionMap.has(region))regionMap.set(region,new Map());if(!regionMap.get(region).has(group))regionMap.get(region).set(group,[]);regionMap.get(region).get(group).push(dealer)});
        const row=(bir,label,level,items)=>{const value=calc(channel,mergeStats(items.flatMap(dealer=>keys.map(key=>dealer.canais[channel].monthly?.[key]))));const visualLabel=level==='group'?`↳ ${label}`:level==='dealer'?`　↳ ${label}`:label;exportRows.push({level,cells:[{v:bir||'-',kind:'text'},{v:label,kind:'text'},...cols.map(([kpi])=>({v:value[kpi],kind:kind(kpi),state:objectiveClass(channel,kpi,value[kpi])}))]});return `<tr class="summary-level-${level}"><td>${esc(bir||'-')}</td><td class="name">${esc(visualLabel)}</td>${cols.map(([kpi])=>`<td class="${objectiveClass(channel,kpi,value[kpi])}">${fmt(value[kpi],kpi)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`};
        [...regionMap.entries()].sort().forEach(([region,groupMap])=>{const regionItems=[...groupMap.values()].flat();rows.push(row('-',region,'region',regionItems));[...groupMap.entries()].sort().forEach(([group,items])=>{rows.push(row('-',group,'group',items));items.sort((a,b)=>a.nome.localeCompare(b.nome)).forEach(dealer=>rows.push(row(dealer.bir||'-',dealer.nome,'dealer',[dealer])))});});
        const all=dealers.filter(dealer=>dealer.canais?.[channel]);rows.push(row('-','Total Geral · Brasil','brazil',all));
        target.querySelector('[data-general-table-wrap]').innerHTML=`<table class="dealerx-table general-summary-table" data-general-table="${channel}"><thead><tr><th>BIR</th><th>Regional / Grupo / Concessionária</th>${cols.map(([,label])=>`<th>${esc(label)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.join('')}</tbody></table>`;
      };
      target.querySelectorAll('[data-gm]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{const key=button.dataset.gm;keys=keys.includes(key)?keys.filter(item=>item!==key):[...keys,key].sort();if(!keys.length)keys=[current];target.querySelectorAll('[data-gm]').forEach(item=>item.classList.toggle('active',keys.includes(item.dataset.gm)));render()});
      target.querySelector('[data-gregion]').onchange=render;target.querySelector('[data-gsearch]').oninput=render;
      target.querySelector('[data-gcopy]').onclick=async event=>{const button=event.currentTarget,old=button.textContent,status=target.querySelector('[data-gstatus]');try{button.textContent='Gerando arquivo...';const period=keys.map(key=>months.find(month=>month.key===key)?.label||key).join(' + ');await window.GeelyExcel.downloadReliable([{name:channel==='vn'?'Vendas':'Pós-Venda',channel,title:`Resumo geral · ${channel==='vn'?'Vendas':'Pós-Venda'}`,subtitle:`Período: ${period} · Arquivo formatado Geely`,headers:['BIR','Regional / Grupo / Concessionária',...cols.map(([,label])=>label)],widths:[15,38,...cols.map(()=>19)],rows:exportRows}],`Resumo_Geral_${channel.toUpperCase()}_Geely.xlsx`);button.textContent='Arquivo gerado';status.className='dealerx-image-status success';status.textContent=`Excel formatado baixado com ${exportRows.length} linhas.`}catch(error){button.textContent='Falha ao gerar';status.className='dealerx-image-status error';status.textContent=error.message||'Não foi possível gerar o arquivo.'}setTimeout(()=>button.textContent=old,1800)};
      render();
    };
    setupChannel('vn');setupChannel('pv');
    pane.querySelectorAll('[data-general-target]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>{pane.querySelectorAll('[data-general-target]').forEach(item=>item.classList.toggle('active',item===button));pane.querySelectorAll('[data-general-pane]').forEach(item=>item.classList.toggle('active',item.dataset.generalPane===button.dataset.generalTarget))});
  }
  generalSummary();

  function searchDealer(){
    const pane=document.getElementById('dealerx-search');if(!pane)return;
    pane.innerHTML=`<div class="dealerx-panel dealerx-search-shell"><div class="dealerx-search-controls"><label>Pesquisar concessionária<input list="dealerx-list" data-input placeholder="Digite nome ou BIR"><datalist id="dealerx-list">${dealers.map(d=>`<option value="${esc(d.nome)}">BIR ${esc(d.bir||'-')}</option>`).join('')}</datalist></label><button class="primary" data-go>Pesquisar</button></div><div data-result class="dealerx-empty">Selecione uma concessionária para analisar todos os indicadores Geely.</div></div>`;
    const go=()=>{const q=norm(pane.querySelector('[data-input]').value),dealer=dealers.find(d=>norm(d.nome)===q||norm(d.bir)===q)||dealers.find(d=>norm(d.nome).includes(q)||norm(d.bir).includes(q));if(!dealer){pane.querySelector('[data-result]').innerHTML='<div class="dealerx-empty">Concessionária não encontrada.</div>';return}let keys=[current];const render=()=>{const channels=['vn','pv'].filter(c=>dealer.canais?.[c]);const cards=channels.map(c=>{const v=values(dealer,c,keys),meta=D.canais[c];return `<section class="dealerx-channel ${c}"><h4>${meta.label} · ${esc(dealer.canais[c].regional)} · ${esc(dealer.canais[c].grupo||'Sem grupo')}</h4><div class="dealerx-kpi-grid">${(meta.kpis||[]).filter(k=>k!=='quantidade').map(k=>`<div class="dealerx-kpi ${k==='nps_index'?'principal':''}"><span>${esc(meta.rotulos[k]||k)}</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(c,k,v[k])}">${fmt(v[k],k)}</strong><small>Objetivo: ${meta.objetivos[k]==null?'sem objetivo':fmt(meta.objetivos[k],k)}</small></div>`).join('')}<div class="dealerx-kpi"><span>Qtnd de pesquisas</span><strong>${fmt(v.quantidade,'quantidade')}</strong></div></div></section>`}).join('');const width=900,height=280,pad=45,x=i=>pad+i*(width-pad*2)/Math.max(1,months.length-1),y=v=>height-pad-(v+100)/200*(height-pad*2);let svg=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}">${[-100,-50,0,50,100].map(v=>`<line x1="${pad}" y1="${y(v)}" x2="${width-pad}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="#e1e6e8"/><text x="5" y="${y(v)+4}" font-size="10">${v}%</text>`).join('')}`;channels.forEach((c,ci)=>{const stroke=ci===0?'#a67c00':'#555',pts=months.map((m,i)=>({m,i,v:values(dealer,c,[m.key]).nps_index})).filter(p=>p.v!=null);if(pts.length)svg+=`<polyline fill="none" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="3" points="${pts.map(p=>`${x(p.i)},${y(p.v)}`).join(' ')}"/>`;pts.forEach(p=>{svg+=`<circle cx="${x(p.i)}" cy="${y(p.v)}" r="4" fill="#fff" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="3"/><text class="dealerx-chart-data-text" x="${x(p.i)}" y="${y(p.v)-10}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${stroke}">${c.toUpperCase()}: ${Number(p.v).toFixed(2).replace('.',',')}%</text>`})});months.forEach((m,i)=>svg+=`<text x="${x(i)}" y="${height-12}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10">${m.label}</text>`);svg+='</svg>';pane.querySelector('[data-result]').innerHTML=`<div class="dealerx-search-head"><div><h3>${esc(dealer.nome)}</h3><p>BIR ${esc(dealer.bir||'-')}</p></div></div><div class="dealerx-toolbar"><div><small>Período da análise</small><div class="dealerx-chips">${months.map(m=>`<button class="dealerx-chip ${keys.includes(m.key)?'active':''}" data-sm="${m.key}">${m.label}</button>`).join('')}</div></div><button class="secondary" data-preset="mtd">MTD</button><button class="secondary" data-preset="h2">H2</button><button class="secondary" data-preset="ytd">YTD</button></div><div class="dealerx-channel-grid">${cards}</div><div class="dealerx-chart"><strong>Evolução mensal · NPS Index</strong>${svg}</div>`;pane.querySelectorAll('[data-sm]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const k=b.dataset.sm;keys=keys.includes(k)?keys.filter(x=>x!==k):[...keys,k];if(!keys.length)keys=[current];render()});pane.querySelectorAll('[data-preset]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{keys=b.dataset.preset==='mtd'?[current]:b.dataset.preset==='h2'?months.filter(m=>Number(m.key.slice(5))>=7).map(m=>m.key):ytdKeys;render()});};render()};pane.querySelector('[data-go]').onclick=go;pane.querySelector('[data-input]').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')go()};
  }
  searchDealer();
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-dealerx-target]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-dealerx-target]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===button));document.querySelectorAll('.dealerx-pane').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active',p.id===`dealerx-${button.dataset.dealerxTarget}`));}));
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
